join hortbot 999 foobar 1



handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list adda repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'repeatme' added, restricted to everyone and above.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeatme add Something
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "Something" has been added to the list as item #1.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat add repeatme 30
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' will now repeat every 30 seconds if at least 1 message has passed.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 10s
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 22s
sleep 100ms
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Something

checkpoint
clock_forward 30s
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list delete repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] List 'repeatme' and its repeat/schedule have been deleted.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :hey
no_send

checkpoint
clock_forward 31s
sleep 100ms
no_send


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!repeat on repeatme
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'repeatme' does not exist.
